caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is a metal teapot or coffee pot set against a plain off-white background. The pot has a slightly conical cylindrical body with a round base that is wider than the top. The spout is long, thin, and curved, positioned on the left side, and the handle is large, curved, and ornate, extending upward on the right side. Both the spout and handle appear to be made of the same metallic material as the pot. The pot is topped with a dome-like lid that has a decorative knob at the peak, and a band with a repeated raised pattern encircles the base of the lid. The main color of the pot is a bluish-gray with various shades and reflective highlights, suggesting a metallic texture. The base of the pot has a slight brownish ring, possibly representing a wooden or different material bottom. The outlines and shadows provide depth, emphasizing the three-dimensional form of the object. There is no additional decorative detail or background element. At the bottom right corner of the drawing, there is text that appears to be a signature: "B. Armsbaugh."
title: Pewter Coffee Pot
